drafts.title: Parallel
drafts.pitch: Null is asked to make tool calls in parallel, and handsets multiply until every answer lands at once.
drafts.reason: Funny 6, clear 6, in-world 8, fresh 7. The slack cords and the whole pile landing at once is a good silent payoff, but the six-cord tangle is busy and 'parallel' takes a beat to read without dialogue.

drafts.title: Million
drafts.pitch: The context window gets upgraded to a million tokens, and Cursor's trip to reread the user's first message becomes an expedition.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 8, in-world 9, fresh 4. The tent and token-block campfire reads instantly, but travelling to the far end of a long context sits too close to Grey Line, so it's capped at 6.
